settings.maxRoundsHelp: A cap that prevents the game from running forever through chains of wars (ties). The game ends when either player runs out of cards or the max round is reached.
settings.speedHelp: How fast each round's animation plays while autoplaying. Faster races to the finish; slower lets each reveal and war play out.

tutorial.cpuPile: CPU's card pile. Shows remaining card count.
tutorial.arena: Battle arena. Revealed cards and pot size shown here.
tutorial.playerPile: Your card pile. You lose when you run out of cards.
tutorial.stepButton: Press this button to flip the next card.
tutorial.autoplayButton: Press this button to auto-flip until the game ends.
